priorities: Most obvious remaining old silhouettes. Reuse the coast visual language; preserve bobbing and the night beam.
Bridge, cable system, grandstands, canal villas, diving school and fort
Eight useful landmark factories already exist. Give them safe standalone preview adapters before making duplicates.
Crate, coin, peel, die, cart, coconut and basket
Important gameplay props are invisible to the review workflow.
Atrapa mango tree and river rowboats
Replace older block geometry while preserving gameplay dimensions.
Ten current resources are preview-only; place selected landmarks with route clearance before expanding the library.
No dedicated current models. Add perched and flying poses around docks.
Adds waterside life distinct from flying ibis and grazing capybaras.
No actual toucan model despite old comments; add canopy and understory behavior.
Coral, sea fan, sponge and sea turtle
Fish already exist; reef habitat is the larger missing layer.
Nest, perch and shoreline feeding behavior
Habitat interaction would add more life than another recolor on a circle.
Current stands and pits need people and activity. Reuse the Pana rig.
Pit tool cart, jack, cones and portable barriers
Build a believable working paddock around existing garages.
Waste bins, drain covers, utility poles and traffic signs
Small everyday details fill gaps between the buildings.
Fishing baskets, anchor, mooring bollard and fish-drying table
Complements the existing fishing boat, net rack and crates.
Add more varied animal routes. Cloud wind now uses absolute time across the shared sky.
